questions.question:
In the following questions, two equations (I) and (II) are given. You have to solve both the equations and establish the relation between x and y.

I. $x^2 - 9x + 20 = 0$
II. $y^2 - 12y + 35 = 0$
questions.explanation:
Equation I: $x^2 - 9x + 20 = 0$
We need two numbers whose product is 20 and sum is 9. These numbers are 4 and 5.
$x^2 - 4x - 5x + 20 = 0$
$x(x - 4) - 5(x - 4) = 0$
$(x - 4)(x - 5) = 0$
So, $x = 4$ or $x = 5$.

Equation II: $y^2 - 12y + 35 = 0$
We need two numbers whose product is 35 and sum is 12. These numbers are 5 and 7.
$y^2 - 5y - 7y + 35 = 0$
$y(y - 5) - 7(y - 5) = 0$
$(y - 5)(y - 7) = 0$
So, $y = 5$ or $y = 7$.

Comparing the values:
When $x = 4$, $y = 5 \implies x < y$
When $x = 4$, $y = 7 \implies x < y$
When $x = 5$, $y = 5 \implies x = y$
When $x = 5$, $y = 7 \implies x < y$
Combining all comparisons, we get $x \le y$.
questions.subject: bank-quant
